**12:00 - 12:30**: Travel to interview (must leave immediately after class to avoid lateness).
**12:30 - 13:30**: Job interview (scheduled for 60 minutes to account for uncertainty).
**13:30 - 14:00**: Travel back to campus (30 minutes).
**14:00 - 17:00**: **3-hour block of focused project work** (meets the deadline requirement).
**17:00 - 18:00**: Optional buffer or additional project work if needed.
